questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: Watch and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop if a train is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing downward is always a yield sign. Slow down or stop if needed to let other traffic pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that cars from the right are joining your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes will soon combine into one.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of slippery road conditions ahead. Slow down because wet pavement makes it harder to stop and easier to skid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to others drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must stop completely and cannot turn until the arrow is gone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of construction or road work ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel at slow speeds to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mark school zones. Be alert for children and obey the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows where pedestrians cross the road. Watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn left at this sign. Turning left here is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards ahead. Orange warning signs tell you about construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows how high a bridge or overpass is. It tells you the clearance distance between the road and the structure above.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Traffic is merging into your lane from another road. Check your mirrors and move over when safe to give merging drivers room.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: Construction or road work is ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic controls and construction equipment.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for other traffic and pedestrians, then proceed only when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians may cross here. Slow down and be ready to stop if someone is crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: The road ahead splits. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Traffic from the right is merging into your lane. Be prepared to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles may cross or travel in this area. Watch for them and be ready to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a pedestrian crosswalk. Pedestrians may cross here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A bicyclist with their left arm straight out is signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: The road ahead will curve or the roadway will narrow. Be ready to adjust your driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending. Move to another lane to avoid traffic that may be merging into your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: You must move in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, move to the left.
